episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: On the holy day of Olympia, Zeus questions his omnipotence. Down on Earth, Riddy — a mere mortal — is more concerned with matters of the heart.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Dionysus has an idea to help Orpheus reach his lost wife. Zeus, annoyed by the mortals' lack of respect for him, shares his own plan with Prometheus.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Zeus demands revenge on the Trojans for desecrating his monument. Ariadne begs her father for the one thing she wants for her birthday — redemption.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The search for Zeus' missing watch turns deadly. Trouble is brewing in the Underworld, as an old friend of Prometheus' meets his destiny.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The Furies offer Ariadne a glimpse into her family's past, while an increasingly paranoid Zeus overhears a secret from his wife in the present.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Orpheus draws closer to Riddy — but she's already become close to somebody else. Hades feels the full force of Zeus' wrath at a gathering of the gods.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: On Olympus, Zeus hosts a barbecue for the gods to watch a prophecy being defied. Down in the Underworld, Riddy prepares for her own to be fulfilled.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Hera calls a family meeting to protect Zeus from himself. But after a climactic meeting with the Fates, Kaos might be coming for the king of the gods.
